rows.quote: We used the latest release data on VTE from the FinnGen study R12 in this analysis, which comprised 26,333 cases 474,015 controls.
GWAS data for VTE were assessed from UK biobank database (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gwas/studies/GCST90038607) [14].
rows.coder_note: Sentence gives a GWAS Catalog accession and a reference for the outcome GWAS; neither belongs to any dictionary row.

rows.quote: Comparatively, the deCODE Health study employed SomaScan platform to measure 4,907 proteomic aptamers in 35,559 Icelandic individuals, identifying instrumentally valid cis-SNPs for 1,423 plasma proteins [13].
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E Sulem P Atlason BA Sveinbjornsson G Magnusson MI Styrmisdottir EL Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease Nat Genet 2021 53 1712 1721 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w 34857953
